text: {"lessons":["I should not treat recent price moves as predictors; prices move randomly, so I should avoid chasing trends or reacting to short-term swings.","A gain on Stock A is not by itself a reason to sell; I should make decisions based on my goals and portfolio, not just its average cost or the size of the gain.","Because losses affect me strongly and I trade infrequently, I should stay disciplined, avoid impulsive decisions, and review whether each trade is truly necessary."]}
